title: Complete quadratic flip neighbor
statement: For an integer $n\ge 2$, let $E_n$ denote the Boolean-cube to binary-cube equivalence, and let $Q_n$ denote the complete quadratic flip-neighbor map on the binary cube. The complete quadratic flip neighbor of $w\in\{0,1\}^n$ is $E_n^{-1}(Q_n(E_n(w)))$.
caveat: The payload does not define the cube equivalence or the binary flip-neighbor map, so their mathematical meanings cannot be stated more fully.
